name: Warehouse — Package Sorting
tagline: Match package types to their corresponding outbound delivery docks.
narrative:
Two packages (one red, one blue) are moving through the warehouse.

Your robot knows how to drive and load packages, but now it must sort them correctly: red packages must go to Red Outbound, and blue packages to Blue Outbound.

Combine the carried cargo type with the delivery station type to make accurate unloading decisions!
objective: Deliver the red package to Red Outbound and the blue package to Blue Outbound.
learningObjective: Combine two facts (carried cargo color + delivery dock color) into specific sorting rules.
intelligenceExplanation:
Pickup and navigation rules are already in the scaffold. Add two typed delivery rules:
1. WHEN deliveryRedHere && carryingRed -> DO deliver
2. WHEN deliveryBlueHere && carryingBlue -> DO deliver

Place both delivery rules above navigation rules so unloading happens immediately upon arrival.
hint: Create two rules: deliveryRedHere && carryingRed -> deliver, and deliveryBlueHere && carryingBlue -> deliver.
hints: Check both the station color below and the cargo color carried.
Combine deliveryRedHere with carryingRed for red packages.
Combine deliveryBlueHere with carryingBlue for blue packages.
brief: Route red packages to Red Outbound and blue packages to Blue Outbound.
context: Two different package types travel down the aisle. Unloading at the wrong dock won't fulfill the order.

steps.label: Deliver the first correctly matched package
Deliver both packages to their matching outbound docks

goals.description: Deliver every package to the correctly typed outbound.

rules.description: Load a package when capacity is free.
Turn right at the end of an aisle.
